entries.cited_text: In one organoid model with increased epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) gene copy number gain and the EGFR p.E746_A750del mutation, sensitivity testing of commonly used antitumor drugs/regimens, including osimertinib, paclitaxel, cisplatin, the GP regimen (gemcitabine plus cisplatin), and the PP regimen (pemetrexed plus cisplatin), showed that osimertinib exhibited potent antitumor activity (IC 50 =1.91 μmol/L), markedly superior to the other tested drugs, and the results were consistent with the clinical response.

checker.reason: The organoid model demonstrates potent sensitivity to osimertinib in the presence of EGFR amplification and the E746_A750del mutation.
